AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Knitting Skills 10 4.2 Constructing Framed Suspended Garden 10 4.3 Adding Value  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
